notes: Page 193 starts a new poem with its own heading, so it is not a continuation of p.192. The Ibn al-Nahwi Munfarija has its hemistichs side by side and its bayts numbered ١), and it runs to bayt ٤٨ on p.195. Page 196 starts بانت سعاد: the heading, then the attribution paragraph and the reading note, then stacked bayts numbered ١- and a :::مفردات block. In this font a vowel above the lam stem of ال belongs to the next letter. Where a sukun ring is fused onto the damma above the lam stem (a glyph like ۿ), it is written as a sukun on the lam of ال: وَالْمُهَجِ, بِالْمُنْتَسَجِ, الْخُلِقِ, الْمُتَوَلِّ, الْمُعْتَلِجِ, الْمُسْتَهْدِ, الْمُسْتَحْيِ, الْخُلُجِ. A plain damma there is written without a sukun on the lam. In p.193 bayt 13 a kasra is printed under the word الله, so it is written اللَّهِ. Elsewhere the bare الله is kept. On p.196 bayt 4 the marks over كأنه are clustered and are written as كَأَنَّهُ. The gloss numbers printed as «١ -» and «٤ -» are written as ١- and ٤-.
